name: Flutter Love
source:
A short otome game about Minna, a new transfer student who begins receiving letters from her deceased father.

[From [url=https://teammochi.itch.io/flutterlove]Itch.io[/url]]

这是一款关于新转校生明娜的短乙女游戏，她开始收到已故父亲的来信。

[来自[url=https://teammochi.itch.io/flutterlove]Itch.io[/url]]
